LESSON: SUNNAH PRAYERS QABLIYAH AND BA'DIYAH

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should a Muslim perform Qabliya and Ba’diyah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah
2. appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah

Teach
• Today’s focus: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah” using a school example.
• Model B for “perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

• Then do Try this.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah
• Model 2: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah
2. Practise: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should a Muslim perform Qabliya and Ba’diyah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
